extracted.intended_audience: book lovers and readers seeking BookTube/YouTube book channels
extracted.subtask_description: Aggregating and ranking YouTube channels that focus on books (BookTube) by surveying existing 'best of' lists and presenting a top selection plus an alphabetical remainder. Includes transparency about sources and caveats about outdated results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Aggregation-and-ranking-by-frequency
rubrics_metrics.description: Aggregate as many 'Best Book Youtube Channel' articles as possible and rank individual channels by how many times they appear across those lists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page states: 'Because of how we put these articles together (aggregate as many “Best Book Youtube Channel” articles as we can find and rank the individual items by how many times they appear)'. Use frequency across independent curated lists as the primary ranking metric.

rubrics_metrics.name: Retain_channels_with_valuable_back_catalogues
rubrics_metrics.description: Keep channels that may no longer be releasing new material if they have a substantial back catalog of videos.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As noted on the page: 'there are a few channels on this list that are no longer releasing new material, but we decided to keep them because they all still have a nice back catalog to go through.' Do not exclude inactive channels solely for inactivity if historical content is useful.

rubrics_metrics.name: Report_lists_each_channel_appears_on
rubrics_metrics.description: For each ranked channel, show which external lists/publications included that channel (supporting evidence for its ranking).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article annotates entries with 'Lists Channel Appears On:' followed by publications (e.g., Book Riot, Huffington Post). Use these citations as the provenance for frequency counts and to help readers assess credibility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top-selection_cutoff_and_alphabetical_remainder
rubrics_metrics.description: Highlight a defined top subset (here, a 'Top 23') and list additional channels not in the top subset separately in alphabetical order.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This page highlights 'The Top 23 Booktube Channels' and then lists 'Best Booktube Channels #24-95' alphabetically, indicating a curated top tier followed by a comprehensive appendix of other noted channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparency_of_sources_used
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a clear list of the source articles and publications used to compile and aggregate the rankings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page includes a 'Top Youtube Book Channel Articles' section listing sources (And Pop, Book Riot, Bustle, etc.), enabling readers to verify methodology and origin of mentions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Methodological_caveat_about_outdatedness
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledge that aggregation-based rankings can become outdated and that some high-ranked items may no longer be current.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The article warns: 'sometimes a top ranking entry may be somewhat outdated.' When using this method, include a caveat about timeliness and consider checking channels' recent activity before treating ranking as current.
